2|//!
3|//! Provides GEMM (matrix multiply) and attention kernels targeting NVIDIA tensor cores.
4|//! Supports two architectures:
5|//! - WGMMA (sm_120, consumer Blackwell: RTX 5060 Ti / 5090)
6|//! - tcgen05 (sm_100, datacenter Blackwell: B200)
7|//!
8|//! ## Architecture
9|//!
10|//! ```text
11|//! kernel/
12|//!   mod.rs          - module root, re-exports
13|//!   device_buf.rs   - DeviceBuffer<T> (host Vec / device ptr abstraction)
14|//!   gemm.rs         - GEMM trait, config, types, CPU fallback
15|//!   builder.rs      - PTX builder, kernel registration, launch config
16|//!   tma_descriptor.rs - Blackwell TMA global cache read descriptor (64-bit hand-packed)
17|//!   tma_bridge.rs   - Bridge to cuda-oxide 128-byte TmaDescriptor + host-side creation
18|//!   kvcache.rs      - KV cache with TMA descriptor support
19|//!   attention.rs    - Attention kernel trait, config, CPU fallback
20|//! ```
21|//!
22|//! ## Build Pipeline
23|//!
24|//! 1. Kernel source written with cuda-oxide `#[kernel]` attribute
25|//! 2. `cargo oxide build` compiles to PTX
26|//! 3. `GemmBuilder` loads PTX and produces launchable `GemmKernel`
27|//! 4. `InferenceEngine` uses `GemmKernel` and `AttentionKernel` for computation
28|//!
29|//! ## KV Cache
30|//!
31|//! KV cache uses TMA descriptors for async GMEM→SMEM copies during attention.
32|//! Layout: `[num_heads * head_dim, max_seq]` contiguous per layer (sequence
33|//! dimension is contiguous for efficient TMA transfers).
34|//!
35|//! ```text
36|//! Kvcache::new(num_heads, head_dim, max_seq, on_device)
37|//!   → append(key, value)
38|//!   → tma_descriptor(gmem_addr, is_key, head_idx, box_y)
39|//!   → KvcacheSlice → to_tma_descriptor()
40|//! ```
41|//!
42|//! ## Attention
43|//!
44|//! Scaled dot-product attention: `softmax(Q @ K^T / sqrt(head_dim)) @ V`
45|//! - Prefill: full KV cache loaded via TMA, all positions processed
46|//! - Decode: single position (box_y=1), append new KV, compute attention over cache
47|//!
48|//! ```text
49|//! AttentionKernel::forward(query, key_cache, value_cache, mask, config)
50|//!   → AttentionSlice from Kvcache
51|//!   → per-head TMA descriptor wiring
52|//!   → output [query_seq_len x (num_heads * head_dim)] f32
53|//! ```
54|//!
55|//! ## Design Decisions
56|//!
57|//! - `DeviceBuffer<T>` abstracts over host Vec and device pointer - no cuda-oxide
58|//!   dependency in the core trait, keeping the crate compileable without GPU toolchain
59|//! - GEMM trait uses f16 inputs with f32 accumulation - matches LLM inference patterns
60|//! - AttentionKernel mirrors GemmKernel pattern (Send + Sync, CPU fallback)
61|//! - PTX builder accepts pre-compiled blobs - cuda-oxide kernels compiled via `cargo oxide`
62|//! - CPU fallback (`CpuGemmKernel`, `CpuAttentionKernel`) enables testing without GPU hardware
63|//! - TMA descriptor is a 128-bit (4 u32) struct matching Blackwell hardware layout
64|//! - KV cache stores K and V in a single contiguous buffer with V offset by head_stride * max_seq
65|//! - tcgen05: K must be divisible by 64 (tile constraint), 128-thread blocks, 128x128x16 tiles
